metadata.title: Grade 7 A2 Complete Core Vocabulary
metadata.description: Phase 4 consolidated and curated master vocabulary bank for Grade 7 ESL learners around CEFR A2. Combines Phases 1–3 into a single importable bank, cleans redundant cross-phase surface duplicates, and preserves stable wordItemId keys for mastery tracking.

curationSummary.policy: Redundant duplicated surface words were replaced in the consolidated master. Stable wordItemId remains the only mastery key.

dataRules: Student progress should be keyed by studentId + wordItemId.
Do not key mastery using normalized word text except as a legacy fallback.
This file contains curriculum content only; student progress belongs in separate mastery tables.
Set-level practiceFocus can map to activity template families.
Item-level practiceTypes can filter compatible question generators.
sourcePackId and sourcePhase are provenance fields and should not be used as mastery keys.
